title: Customer addresses
body:
Customers need delivery addresses on file.

Add `add_address(customer_id, line, city)` to `parcelo/customers.py`. It creates an `Address` with an id, the customer id, the street line and the city, stores it, and returns it. Add the `Address` dataclass to `parcelo/models.py` (fields `id`, `customer_id`, `line`, `city`) and a new `addresses` collection to `parcelo/store.py`, reset in `reset()` like the others, so addresses live in `db.addresses`.

Adding an address for a customer that does not exist must fail. An empty street line or an empty city must fail too.
